questions.stem: A person walks 3 km east and then 4 km north. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Displacement = √(3²+4²) = √(9+16) = √25 = 5 km. Classic 3-4-5 right triangle.

questions.stem: A person walks 10 km south, then 10 km east. In which direction is the starting point from his current position?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Current position is 10 km south and 10 km east of start. So the starting point is 10 km north and 10 km west of the current position — i.e., North-West.

questions.stem: Ram faces East and turns 90° clockwise. Which direction does he now face?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Clockwise from East: E→S→W→N. A 90° clockwise turn from East = South.

questions.stem: A man walks 4 km north, 3 km east, 4 km south, then 3 km west. Where does he end up relative to his start?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Net N-S: 4 north − 4 south = 0. Net E-W: 3 east − 3 west = 0. He returns exactly to his starting point.

questions.stem: Seema starts facing East. She turns 90° anticlockwise twice, then 180°. Which direction does she face finally?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Start: East. 90° anticlockwise → North. 90° anticlockwise again → West. 180° turn → East.

questions.stem: Standing facing north, a person walks 6 km north, then turns left and walks 8 km. How far is she from her starting point?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Facing north, turns left = now facing west. Path: 6 km north + 8 km west. Distance = √(6²+8²) = √(36+64) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.stem: A person walks 5 km west, then 12 km south. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Distance = √(5²+12²) = √(25+144) = √169 = 13 km. (5-12-13 right triangle.)

questions.stem: A person goes 5 km north, 4 km east, 2 km south, 4 km west, then 3 km north. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Net N-S: 5−2+3 = 6 km north. Net E-W: 4−4 = 0. Displacement = 6 km due north.

questions.stem: Two friends A and B start from the same point. A walks 3 km east, turns left and walks 4 km. B walks 4 km north, turns right and walks 3 km. What is the distance between A and B?

options.option_text: 0 km — they meet at the same point

questions.explanation: A is correct. A: (0,0)→(3,0) east→turns left (north)→(3,4). B: (0,0)→(0,4) north→turns right (east)→(3,4). Both end at (3,4). Distance = 0.

questions.stem: Kiran starts from home, walks 6 km east, turns right, walks 8 km, turns left, walks 4 km, turns left, walks 8 km. How far is Kiran from home, and in which direction?
questions.explanation: B is correct. (0,0)→6E→(6,0), face E turn right→face S, 8S→(6,−8), face S turn left→face E, 4E→(10,−8), face E turn left→face N, 8N→(10,0). End point (10,0) is 10 km due East of home.
